name: Chandrayaan-3
about: Chandrayaan-3 (2023-098A, ISRO), launched 2023 Jul 14. Its phases from GCAT: Luna, 32.32E 69.37S. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.
